title: HPA XML Parser: per-sample RNA expression from Human Protein Atlas per-gene XML files
description: Python package, command-line tool, Shiny app and notebook that extract per-sample, gene-level RNA expression (nTPM, sex, age) for human tissues, human, pig and mouse brain regions and immune cells from Human Protein Atlas per-gene XML files, together with HPA's aggregated values and the HPA/Ensembl release information.
